name: descriptions
title: Descriptions
description: A read-only list of field/value pairs — a record's metadata, a summary panel. Real <dl>/<dt>/<dd> so it reads as a description list to a screen reader. Distinct from a form (no inputs) and from a Table (no rows of records).
docs: Part of the AI Design System. Its full contract — every prop, its allowed values and what each one means — is at https://github.com/axdes/AI-Design-system/blob/main/registry/Descriptions.json
